question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Arrogant
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"arrogant"** means having an exaggerated sense of one's own importance or abilities. (अहंकारी)

 
 
• **Example:** The **arrogant **manager refused to listen to any suggestions from his team.
 
 
 
• **"Humble"** refers to having or showing a modest or low estimate of one's own importance. (विनम्र)
 
 
• **Example:** Despite his great achievements, he remained **humble **and always gave credit to his team.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'arrogant'** is **'humble'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Creepy** (डरावना): Causing an unpleasant feeling of fear or unease.

 
 
• **Example:** The old house had a **creepy **atmosphere that scared everyone away.
 
 
 
• **Clumsy** (अनाड़ी): Awkward in movement or handling things.
 
 
• **Example:** He is so **clumsy **that he often drops and breaks things.
 
 
 
• **Average** (औसत): Of the usual or ordinary standard, level, or quantity.
 
 
• **Example:** Her performance was just **average**, nothing extraordinary.
